items:
​​Maison Moon by Oversee 30A | 2026 Diamond Winner-Best Rental Mgmt

Featured on HGTV, Maison Moon is pure 30A sophistication, with a wink. Inside the private gates of Watersound West Beach, this four-bedroom retreat was thoughtfully designed for upscale relaxation and comfort, offering a unique blend of luxury and privacy.

There’s a private pool (an oasis!) for cooling off, a carriage house for spreading out, and easy beach access. Simply, it’s all you need for an unforgettable 30A vacation.

Highlights:
📍 Watersound West Beach
🏖️ Short walk to beach via scenic boardwalk!
🏊‍♂️ Private pool oasis! (optional heat)
🛏️ 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath (includes detached carriage house)
🏡 Spacious, open layout with designer interiors
🍴 Gourmet kitchen, indoor/outdoor dining, gas grill
🚲 4 adult bikes for exploring 30A and nature trails!
📺 Smart TVs
🕶️ Close to Seaside, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach
🛍️ Nearby dining and shopping at The Hub and The Big Chill

Perfect for families, groups, or multi-generational getaways, the main house features open living and multiple sleeping areas, ideal for both adults and kids. The gourmet kitchen opens to a generous living space and outdoor patio, perfect for home-cooked meals or takeout nights.

Upstairs, the primary suite includes a private sitting area and spa-style bathroom with dual shower and soaking tub.

The detached carriage house is its own little getaway with a bedroom, bath, living space, and balcony included. Great for grandparents, in-laws, or that one friend who needs “quiet time” after beach day number three.

Whether you're biking to the beach, gathering by the pool, or watching the stars from the balcony, Maison Moon is your gateway to a truly relaxing coastal vacation.

And because it’s an Oversee 30A home, your stay comes with local care that’s anything but ordinary. Our nearby team is available every day (and night) to make sure your vacation feels effortless from start to finish.

Overview:
-4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms
-Located in Watersound West Beach (gated community)
-Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details)
-Detached carriage house
-Sleeps 16
-4 adult bikes included
-Gas grill + indoor/outdoor dining
-Smart TVs + Wi-Fi
-Washer/dryer
-On-site parking for 4 vehicles (2 garage, 2 driveway)

Note: Outdoor fire pit not available for guest use
HOA requires bikes to be walked between the clubhouse and the beach walkover

Overnight:
FIRST FLOOR
-Guest Bedroom 1: Two twin beds, shared full bath (shower only)
-Guest Bedroom 2: Twin-over-twin bunk bed + twin bed with twin trundle, shared full bath (shower only)
SECOND FLOOR
-Primary Bedroom: King bed, sitting area, wet bar, spa-style bath with dual shower + soaking tub
-Open Sleeping Area: Twin-over-twin bunk bed + twin bed with twin trundle
CARRIAGE HOUSE
-Guest Bedroom 3: King bed, separate living area with queen sleeper sofa, full bath (shower only), private balcony

Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CST
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
